k-sym-ANGEL.title: Sonny Angel $ANGEL coins
k-sym-ANGEL.sourceSays: Posts say Sonny Angel, a Japanese collectible around since 2004, is #1 on WantPop's trending products index and call it the next Labubu; the claims are unverified.
k-sym-ANGEL.reason: Two posts of Nov 14 describe the Sonny Angel collectible and its WantPop ranking as the story; the rest are call-group shills, and the ranking claim is unverified.
